verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a notarization and document-workflow service, so bulk-sending one document to many recipients is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never documents sending the same document to many recipients at once. 'B2B bulk notarization' refers to processing volume, and 'manage signers' does not establish a bulk-send capability, so both are only adjacent.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can bulk-send the same document to many recipients at once
